name: To Those Who Were Seperated
source:
You woke up in a fantasy world where people are talking unintelligible language.

-Learn their words from zero. 
-Type your own reaction and get the characters to learn your language.
-Fall in love with characters in different story branches.  
-Discover the truth of why you are here.

[From [url=https://xlores-liang.itch.io/to-those-who-were-seperated]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个幻想世界中醒来，那里的人们正在谈论难以理解的语言。

-从零开始学习他们的单词。
- 输入你自己的反应，让角色学习你的语言。
-爱上不同故事分支中的角色。
- 发现你为何来到这里的真相。

[来自[url=https://xlores-liang.itch.io/to-those-who-were-seperated]Itch.io[/url]]
